steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Tsk, these things sure are strong, but don't they have brains? It's like fighting a bunch of rocks, a little let down.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Behind you!
Before she finishes, a white figure lunges over. Matilda fires at them but the figure seems unscathed and crashes hard into Corso, sending her flying.
The new opponent is completely different from the others on the battlefield. No doubt an elite, the figure possesses awe-inspiring power.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hehe... Hehehe...

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Ha! Finally! A proper f***ing fight at last!

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Stay calm, Corso. You can't beat her, be careful!

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: I don't care! I'm sick of those lifeless things. This is the real fight worth having!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Subdue them. Facilitate the troops' operation.

steps.speaker: White-Cloaked Elite
steps.content: ....Copy that.
The intense battle resumes. The white-clad elite single-handedly holds back Matilda and Corso, even suppressing these two Sinners. Schorl advances toward the infirmary and stirs up waves of panic.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: There are too many injured patients, Lavina, we can't take everyone. What should we do?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Their target is ${PlayerName}, so they are most likely coming after...
Her heart is instantly seized by fear. Lavina picks up Hella and makes for the exit, but a bullet suddenly pierces through her calf. She falls to her knees.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Lavina!
Hearing the cry, Matilda wants to catch up to them, but she's held back by the white-clad elite.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: ...To think Paradeisos combat unit are this powerful.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: They claim this is a rescue mission for the Chief of Minos, yet the squad consists of no MBCC members and uses such an aggressive approach... This isn't a rescue, it's a capture.
The problem is... ${PlayerName} isn't here. What exactly happened?

In the infirmary, the arrival of the intruders brings about mass panic. The wounded are crying and crawling away from the center of the chaos. There, Schorl looks down at Lavina, who is holding onto Hella tightly.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: A Sinner... Identity confirmed: S-098. ${PlayerName} was indeed carrying out a mission with her before going missing.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: SHP-13 is indeed here.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: No! You've got it wrong. ${PlayerName} isn't here. Nobody knows where he is.
steps.female_content: No! You've got it wrong. ${PlayerName} isn't here. Nobody knows where she is.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Please let me know if you find him. The poor kid needs ${PlayerName}, many others do too.
steps.female_content: Please let me know if you find her. The poor kid needs ${PlayerName}, many others do too.

steps.content: The Lavina a year ago would never think of speaking to a Paradeisian. But now she is indeed showing her utmost sincerity, all for the unconscious girl in her arms.
But the cold schorl is deaf to her pleading. It's only capable of calculating its own tasks, potential enemies, and risks.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Are you hiding our target? Why are you hindering the city-state's plan? What's your relationship with the Underground?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Hand over this Sinner. Wake her up and find SHP-13!

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: No!!
Several HUSH humanoids break into the infirmary and pounce on their prey, following their orders. Lavina turns around and shields Hella with her whole body.
At this moment, countless shadows snake near them across the ground, leaping up to impale all the attackers.
The leader of the Homeless, also the source of the shadows, finally arrives. This chaos has clearly ignited her fury.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Get out of my way. Don't make me say it again.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Do all of you enjoy throwing your power at those weaker than you? Paradeisos and Syndicate are the same in this regard. Both are equally repugnant.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You're harboring an S-Class Sinner. This place is clearly a den of the rebels.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: How dare you act so high and mighty after barging into someone's home, calling us rebels... Why don't you teach me what a rebellion really is?
The powerful ones get entangled with each other and neither is willing to back off. On the other hand, the powerless refugees only feel endless fear.

They have never seen a fight like this, which reminds them of the terrifying rumors. Driven by fear that has been suppressed for eight months or even longer, the agitated crowd begin fleeing in utter panic.

steps.speaker: Panicking Refugee
steps.content: They're fighting... That Guardian kid is buying us time. Run! I don't want to die, run... But where else can we go?

steps.speaker: Panicking Refugee
steps.content: Wait. Perhaps it can be explained. Not everyone sent by the city-state is bad, I mean, look at Matilda... Maybe they really just came to search for a missing person. Just do as they say. We can talk it out.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Everyone, stay calm! Don't panic!

steps.speaker: Panicking Refugee
steps.content: How can we stay calm? Everyone knows the Executive Committee is pushing that... that Purge Order... Remember those rumors!?
Gradually, indistinct whispers begin spreading among the restless crowd.

steps.speaker: Strange Refugee
steps.content: Yes... That's not a rumor... It's all true...

steps.speaker: Strange Refugee
steps.content: They've always looked down on us and West District... Saying that we brought it upon ourselves and that we deserve to be purged... When they're the ones who humiliate and exploit us...

steps.speaker: Underground Puppet
steps.content: Everything is an excuse... See, the Purge Order is coming. The missing person and rebellion are all excuses. They are going to kill us all!

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: The M-value is rising, what's...

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Hella!
[Scene change] Sickbed

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cough cough...! Uh...!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: That's bad! The contamination below suddenly got...
[Scene change] Inside the Maze

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Mmph!!!

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Hang in there, Hecate!
Black spikes suddenly pierce through the young girl's body. The pain is not just physical, but also mind-searing.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: My head hurts... The shackles... The shackles...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief... Something happened to Chief...
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The Black Ring's activity is surging. The M-value has soared to a dangerous level! The maze is rapidly expanding, and BR-002 itself also...

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...starting to expand outward?!
He grits his teeth, making up his mind.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: This is the first time I've ventured so deep into the contaminated area, and it might also be the last. I can't waste this opportunity. I must continue further and try to get more information.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Those who are willing to follow me, come along!
Donald silently watches them make up their minds. This scene reminds him of a distant past, and he can already imagine what outcome awaits these soldiers if they continue to press on.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...You're going the wrong way. If your only goal is to resist Mania and protect the public, then don't rush in and get yourselves killed.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Go back. The blockade line and the anti-Mania gear and strategies are all useless without someone to operate them. You are all experienced FAC soldiers. Don't waste your precious lives here.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: In this maze, there are still people in danger who need your protection. Take them with you. As for me, I'll stay behind and gather any information this Black Ring has to offer.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: This is an old acquaintance I've known for nine years. If someone must stay, it should be me...
Now... Let's take a gamble, shall we?
He can still buy some time for that person.
